items.description: Signed RB Ian Wheeler to the practice squad.
Signed DE Chris Braswell to the practice squad. Released LB Kenneth Murray from the practice squad.
Re-signed CB Anthony Kendall and WR Chris Moore to the practice squad. Signed CB Anthony Kendall to the practice squad.
Designated RB Dylan Sampson to return from injured reserve. Signed C Vershon Lee to the practice squad.
Designated DT Jordon Riley to return from injured reserve.
Designated TE Carter Runyon to return from injured reserve.
Signed K Blake Grupe. Signed OLB Garrett Nelson to the practice squad. Placed CB Damarion Williams on the practice squad exception list. Released OLB Jamie Sheriff from the practice squad.
Designated WR A.J. Brown and OT Marcus Bryant to return from injured reserve.
Signed RB Jarquez Hunter and WR Kevin Austin to the practice squad. Designated LS Zach Woods to return from injured reserve.
Signed OL Josh Gesky to the practice squad. Released DT C.J. Ravenell.
Designated WR Omar Cooper Jr. to return from injured reserve. Re-signed LB Troy Reeder to the practice squad. Signed WR Jamaal Pritchett and DE Quinton Bell to the practice squad.
Designated DB Jakorian Bennett, TE Grant Calcaterra, G Landon Dickerson and TE Eli Stowers to return from their respective injured lists. Signed DB Dean Clark to the practice squad.

Signed TE Shawn Bowman from the practice squad to the active roster. Designated S Kitan Crawford to return from injured reserve. Signed RB Jerome Ford, WR Shedrick Jackson and LB Riley Wilson to the practice squad. Released LB Eugene Asante and DL Jay Toia from the practice squad.
Signed QB Jake Browning to the practice squad. Placed TE Evan Svoboda on the practice squad/injured list.
Promoted RB Velus Jones to the active roster. Released WR Irv Charles and re-signed him to the practice squad.
Designated WR Ja'Kobi Lane to return from injured reserve. Re-signed WR Chris Moore to the practice squad.

Reinstated RT Braden Smith from injured reserve. Signed QB Mark Gronowski and WR Bryce Oliver to the practice squad. Designated LB Henry To'oTo'o and CB Ja'Marcus Ingram to return from injured reserve. Waived LB Chris Braswell.
Signed LB Michael Danna. Waived CB Anthony Kendall.
Activated DL Shemar Turner off the PUP list.

Signed RB Audric Estime to the active roster. Placed RB Raheim Sanders on injured reserve. Signed TE Devin Culp and G Vershon Lee to the practice squad. Released CB Myles Bryant and WR James Proche II from the practice squad.
Signed RB Emari Demercado. Signed G Nick Leverett to the practice squad. Released CB Alex Austin from the practice squad.
Signed CB Elijah Culp to the practice squad. Released G Josh Gesky from the practice squad.
Signed LB Germaine Pratt to the practice squad. Signed TE Pharaoh Brown to the active roster.
Signed WR Justin Watson to the practice squad. Placed WR Tyquan Thornton on injured reserve. Signed LB Cam Jones to the active roster.
Waived K Harrison Mevis.
